newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to upgrade German tanks for C$145 mln.
newsitem.headline: Canada to upgrade German tanks for C$145 mln.

text.p: The Canadian government will spend C$145 million to upgrade its German-made Leopard tanks to permit better sight at night and in poor weather, Defense Minister Douglas Young said Wednesday.
The vehicles will be refurbished with German Leopard 1A5 turrets, equipped with a modernized fire-control system.

"The prime contract will be negotiated in 1997 with German industry to remove and modify the turrets, and a sub-contract will be awarded to a Canadian company to install them in our tanks in Canada," a briefing note said.
The project is expected to be completed by 2001.
